items.title: Finitely many points of a quasi-affine scheme or a scheme with an ample invertible sheaf lie in an affine open

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if X is quasi-affine, or a locally closed subscheme of an affine scheme, or carries an ample invertible sheaf, or is a locally closed subscheme of a projective spectrum, then any finite subset of X lies in an affine open (statement lines 5460-5473). The proof (proof lines 5475-5507) reduces the cases to the projective one, covers the finite set by finitely many standard opens avoiding the complement, and merges them into a single standard open by a graded argument. H2: a reduction plus a two-step covering argument, written out in full.
